## About
At OxyHyperbaric in Shenandoah, Texas, we enhance well-being through advanced mild hyperbaric oxygen therapy. FDA-approved chambers with experienced professionals deliver personalized care for recovery and wellness & longevity goals.

## Specialty wellness programs (MHBOT)
1. Post-Surgical Recovery Wellness — supervised sessions supporting post-surgical recovery
2. Stroke Recovery Wellness Support — cognitive clarity and vitality goals
3. Autism Wellness Hyperbaric Therapy — families explore autism-related wellness support
4. Fibromyalgia Wellness Support — comfort and wellness goals
5. Diabetes Wellness & Vitality — energy and vitality support

## FAQ
Q: What is mild hyperbaric oxygen therapy (MHBOT)?
A: A wellness & longevity approach in a pressurized chamber where increased oxygen may help the body respond to inflammation, improve oxygenation, and support mitochondrial function (your cells' energy centers).

Q: Where is OxyHyperbaric located?
A: 256 Ed English Dr Bldg 4, Ste. E, Shenandoah, TX 77384 — serving The Woodlands and Houston area.

Q: How much does a session cost?
A: $95 intro, $450 (5), $750 (10), $1,400 (20) + 8.25% TX tax.

Q: How do I book?
A: Online at https://oxy-agenda.vercel.app/booking/us or call (713) 591-3379. Booking required.

Q: Post-surgical recovery?
A: Yes — MHBOT wellness & longevity sessions in FDA-approved chambers.

Q: Stroke recovery wellness?
A: Supervised sessions may support cognitive clarity and vitality (wellness only).

Q: Autism wellness?
A: Yes — supervised sessions families explore for autism-related wellness.

Q: Fibromyalgia and diabetes wellness?
A: Yes — MHBOT sessions for fibromyalgia comfort and diabetes vitality goals.

## Disclaimer
MHBOT is for general wellness & longevity and relaxation only. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. FDA-cleared chambers for specific medical uses under physician supervision — wellness & longevity applications are off-label. Results vary.
